correctness.rationale: An output for a weight-two (i,j) is the same pair, or (i-1,j) if i>0, or (i,j-1) if j>i+1. Intersection of balls iff the coordinate difference is one of six nearest-neighbor displacements of the triangular grid. The residue i+2j mod3 is an independent coloring; color 2 has floor(n(n+1)/6) vertices. Each three-top-row strip S_m admits exactly m triangles and edge+singleton cliques, bounding an independent set by m+2, and induction using n-3 closes the upper bound; n=2,3,4 bases checked. Independent exhaustive maximum independent set search verified n=2..9.
